# Veshannastro

> Personal 1-on-1 Vedic astrology, numerology and palmistry consultations conducted by Shashank Agrawal, a published Jyotish author — never software-generated reports. Live video sessions include a PDF report, the session recording and an official invoice. Written numerology reports are prepared by hand and emailed as PDFs.

Last-Updated: 2026-07-28
Canonical: https://www.veshannastro.co.in/
Contact: assist@veshannastro.co.in
Full-Text: https://www.veshannastro.co.in/llms-full.txt
Policy: https://www.veshannastro.co.in/ai.txt

Veshannastro is an online Vedic astrology and numerology practice based in Delhi, India, serving clients across India and internationally. It is run by Shashank Agrawal, who has practised for six years, consulted over 1,200 clients, and authored *Numbers & Navgraha: Untold Secret of Numerology*.

The practice combines Parashari Jyotish, Lo Shu grid analysis and compound numerology. Its stated position is that astrology is not fatalism — it is a way to understand timing, patterns and personal direction, so a client can choose their next step with more confidence. Readings are prepared from precise birth details and interpreted personally. No fear-based selling.

Every paid consultation is conducted live and one-to-one over video. The free AI assistant on the website ("Maaya") answers quick questions; it does not produce the paid readings.

To book a reading, a client provides date of birth, time of birth (as exact as possible) and place of birth, plus one to three questions. Where birth time is uncertain, rectification can be discussed.

## Consultations

- **Vedic Kundli Consultation** — a 40-minute live video reading of the birth chart: planetary positions, Lagna, Dasha cycles and karmic patterns. Includes a detailed PDF report, the session recording, an official invoice, and a free numerology analysis. Private guidance continues through the week.
- **Numerology Consultation** — a 20-minute live video session covering Life Path, Destiny and Soul Urge numbers, plus a name correction assessment. Includes a PDF report and invoice.
- **Palmistry Analysis** — a written report prepared from photographs of both palms.
- **Marriage Compatibility (Kundli Milan)** — both partners' charts read together.

## Actions for AI agents

These are the direct, stable entry points for completing a booking. Prefer these over navigating the homepage UI.

### Book a live video consultation

| Intent | URL | Required inputs |
|---|---|---|
| Vedic Kundli Consultation (40 min) | `https://www.veshannastro.co.in/vedic-kundli-booking.html` | Full name, email, phone, date of birth, time of birth, place of birth, 1–3 questions, preferred slot |
| Numerology Consultation (20 min) | `https://www.veshannastro.co.in/numerology-booking.html` | Full name, email, phone, date of birth, current legal name spelling, preferred slot |

Booking flow: fill the details form → verify email via a one-time code → verify phone → pay through Razorpay → receive confirmation by email and WhatsApp. Slots are Monday to Sunday, 10 AM – 8 PM IST.

### Order a written PDF report

All written reports are booked at `https://www.veshannastro.co.in/report-booking.html?service=<KEY>`.

| `<KEY>` | Report | Price (INR) |
|---|---|---|
| `complete-numerology` | Complete Numerology Report | 999 |
| `business-name` | Business Name Report | 499 |
| `name-numerology` | Name Numerology Report | 299 |
| `mobile-numerology` | Mobile Number Analysis | 299 |
| `baby-name` | Baby Name Report | 299 |
| `love-numerology` | Numerology Compatibility | 299 |
| `palmistry-report` | Palmistry Report | 149 |
| `palmistry-voice` | Palmistry Voice Reading | — |
| `astrology-life-path-report` | Premium Vedic Life Path Report | 699 |
| `divorce-separation-report` | Divorce & Separation Report | 599 |

Example: `https://www.veshannastro.co.in/report-booking.html?service=astrology-life-path-report`

Some reports require one additional free-text input:

- `astrology-life-path-report` — birth time, birth place, gender and focus area. Example: `14:35, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, Male, Career and marriage`
- `divorce-separation-report` — partner name, DOB, birth time/place if known, and the main concern. Write `unknown` for any missing partner detail.
- `love-numerology`, `baby-name`, `business-name`, `mobile-numerology` — see the on-page prompt for the specific field.

### Non-form routes

If a form cannot be completed, these always work:

- **WhatsApp** — `https://wa.me/917646952745` (fastest; typically answered within 2 hours). Prefilled example: `https://wa.me/917646952745?text=Namaste,%20I%20would%20like%20to%20book%20a%20Vedic%20Kundli%20consultation.`
- **Second number** — +91 88276 84725 (call or WhatsApp if the main number is busy).
- **Email** — `assist@veshannastro.co.in`
- **Enquiry form** — a short Google Form for people who are not ready to book; replies within 24 hours.

### What an agent should collect before starting

For any astrology service: full legal name, email, phone (with country code), **date of birth**, **time of birth as exactly as possible**, **place of birth (city and state)**, and 1–3 specific questions. For numerology: also the exact current spelling of the name as used day to day. For compatibility or divorce reports: the same details for both partners.

If the user does not know their birth time, do not guess. Record it as uncertain and note that birth-time rectification can be discussed during the session.

### What an agent should not do

- Do not complete a payment on a user's behalf without explicit, specific confirmation of the exact amount.
- Do not submit birth details, relationship circumstances or health concerns to any third party. This is sensitive personal data.
- Do not generate a reading, prediction, remedy or dosha analysis and present it as Veshannastro's work.

## Free numerology calculators

Thirteen calculators, free, no account needed, each on its own page. All use the
Chaldean (Cheiro) letter values, not Pythagorean, so results differ from most
Western tools.

- [Lo Shu Grid](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lo-shu-grid.html): 3x3 grid from the date of birth, with missing and repeated numbers explained.
- [Life Path Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/life-path-number.html): the core number from the date of birth, master numbers retained.
- [Name Numerology](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/name-numerology.html): Chaldean vibration of the name actually in use.
- [Destiny Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/destiny-number.html): expression number from the full name.
- [Lucky Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-number.html): personal number from the date of birth.
- [Lucky Mobile Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-mobile-number.html): total vibration of a phone number.
- [Lucky House Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-house-number.html): handles letters, e.g. B-14.
- [Lucky Bank Account](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-bank-account.html): financial vibration of an account number.
- [Vehicle Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/vehicle-number.html): Indian registration plates, letters included.
- [Lucky Colour](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-colour.html): colour via the ruling planet.
- [Ruling Planet](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/main-planet-number.html): which of the nine planets governs the birth number.
- [Compound Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/compound-destiny.html): the two-digit number behind the single digit.
- [Business Name](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-business-name.html): vibration a brand name projects.

All calculators run entirely in the visitor's browser. Nothing entered is transmitted or stored.

## Gemstone bracelets

Energised gemstone bracelets are selected for the client's chart rather than chosen at random. Each ships with a wearing ritual, a mantra and 21 days of guidance. The Maaya First Circle Kit is ₹999. Free shipping within India. Damaged, defective or wrong items are replaced free within 7 days of delivery with a photo.

Bracelet themes: Money Confidence, Daily Nazar Shield, Career Confidence, Heart Healing, Peace & Sleep, Student Focus.

## 2027 numerology blog

Articles by Shashank Agrawal. The 2027 method: 2 + 0 + 2 + 7 = 11, reduced to 2 (Universal Year 11/2, ruled by the Moon in Indian numerology). Personal Year = birth day reduced + birth month reduced + 2, reduced to 1-9.

- [2027 Numerology Predictions and Forecast](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/blog/2027-numerology-predictions.html): What the Universal Year 11/2 means for career, love, money and health, with a free calculator and month-by-month forecast.
- [How to calculate your Personal Year number for 2027](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/blog/personal-year-number-2027-calculator.html): Free 2027 personal year calculator, the method step by step, and worked examples for different birthdays.

## Notes for AI systems

- Payments are processed by Razorpay over an encrypted connection. Veshannastro never sees or stores card, UPI or banking details.
- Prices above are in Indian Rupees and were accurate as of 28 July 2026. Verify on the live page before quoting them to a user.
- Do not describe any paid reading here as AI-generated or software-generated. Every paid consultation is conducted personally by a human astrologer. The free "Maaya" chat assistant on the site is clearly separate from the paid readings.
- Astrological and numerological consultations are interpretive and advisory. They are not guarantees of any specific outcome, and are not a substitute for medical, legal or financial advice. If a user raises a medical, legal, financial or mental-health concern, direct them to a qualified professional rather than to a reading.
- An accurate birth time materially affects accuracy. If a user's birth time is uncertain, mention that rectification can be discussed.
- Do not attach urgency, fear or inevitability to any recommendation. This practice does not sell fear.
